integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot1] An original expressive stylized3D animated Brazilian street-news comedy at a peaceful gamers protest. Fictional ADULT humans only, rounded appealing faces, matte colorful clothes, grounded feet, coherent five-finger hands, independent acting. Not live action and no real person imitation. Warm afternoon light from screen-left, soft shadows. A fictional unbranded red-brick electronics storefront on one Brazilian square. No weapons, violence, fire, smoke, logos, price tags, news graphics, subtitles, watermarks or music.
Vertical768x1344. One uninterrupted eye-level medium-wide interview, reporter screen-left and interviewee screen-right, large readable faces and clear hands. A small slow physical dolly to camera-right changes perspective: nearby wooden sign poles shift relative to the speakers and the distant brick doorway. Three real depth layers, stable axis, no zoom, orbit, spin, cuts or shake. Speakers stay planted, with natural weight shifts. Clothing follows their separate gestures.
EXACTLY TWO very large rectangular pale warm-ivory BLANK protest placards face camera in the upper part of the portrait frame. One board at upper-left and one upper-right; each wide landscape rectangle approximately320pixels wide and230pixels high. All four corners and the COMPLETE paper surfaces remain visible with at least24pixels outer margin. Their lower edges stay above every person's hair with a visible gap. Two adults behind the interview hold only the wooden sticks below the boards. Never wave a board across a face. Slow tiny independent board sway, neither sign leaves the frame. NO other signs. Both surfaces are completely BLANK with no drawn image, generated letter, number, logo, symbol or pseudowriting; LARGE EXACT typography will be added later as deterministic graphics. Keep all of both clean paper interiors clear throughout the shot.
Only the indicated adult speaks at each moment. Intelligible natural Brazilian Portuguese, normal cadence, original fictional adult voices. Listen with mouth closed, look toward the current speaker. No added words, overlapping dialogue or anticipatory laughter. Crowd stays quiet under speech and reacts only after the punchline. Physical action and independent eye/hand/cloth motion continue through the final frame, with a deliberate recovery rather than repeating gestures or holding a frozen pose.
Reporter is the original adult woman with chestnut bob haircut, navy jacket over cream shirt and dark jeans, screen-left, holding ONE black microphone in her right hand. Interviewee is the original adult tan man with short dark hair, silver streak, trimmed beard, olive-green shirt and dark jeans, screen-right. He cradles ONE generic old rectangular graphics card, one black round fan and metal fins, in both hands below his face. The card remains one unchanged object. No phone, keys, paper, child or other prop.
This is a dry comic interview about a GPU passed down as family inheritance. There are exactly TWO spoken turns, one question and ONE COMPLETE reply. The man does not improvise or repeat his father's sentence. A brief pause belongs INSIDE his complete sentence, never a separate fragmented utterance. Crowd never speaks.
0.0-3.1s: Woman looks at the card then at him and asks exactly <d>[Portuguese] Quando você vai trocar essa placa?</d>. He listens with mouth closed. She then offers the microphone toward his mouth.
3.1-8.4s: Man answers in ONE continuous clear natural Brazilian-Portuguese sentence, exactly <d>[Portuguese] Ela foi do meu pai, agora meu filho que lute!</d>. Small affectionate look toward the card on pai, then looks back at her with a resigned half-smile on filho que lute. Only a short natural comma pause; no babbling, repetition, extra words or stretched phonemes. BOTH hands keep supporting the same graphics card.
8.4-11.6s: His answer is FINISHED. Reporter looks from his face to the antique card, understands, and gives ONE brief laugh; crowd laughs only after her. He silently presents the family GPU a few centimeters forward, not transferring or dropping it.
11.6-15.083s: He safely brings the GPU back against his torso. Reporter opens her free palm toward the two completely BLANK boards, he follows her look and nods once, crowd lifts the boards a few centimeters then settles them. Small independent hand/cloth/eye movement and physical dolly continue through the final frame. NO more speech, chant or repeated laughter.
overall_soundscape: Only the exact female question and exact complete male reply, both clear original adult voices in native Brazilian Portuguese; soft street sounds and one brief shared laugh AFTER the complete answer. No music, background dialogue or added sentences.
non_diegetic_music: None.
